title: Atomic namespace entry exchange through daemon APIs
scope: Namespace::exchange, resident fs-exchange SOURCE TARGET RPC, and offline fs-exchange CONTAINER SOURCE TARGET
Atomic swap of two existing final directory entries without following final symlinks; supports files, directories, symlinks, and nonempty directories
Both directory-cycle directions, same-parent and cross-parent net link accounting, synthetic modern-backend EMLINK boundaries, and failure atomicity
